type: ({ agentPresentation, permissions, onPermissionChange, memoryEnabled, onMemoryEnabledChange, memory, onMemoryPauseChange, onMemoryDelete, contextUsage, models, model, onModelChange, title, headingLevel, labels, appearance, }: AssistantControlsProps) => JSX.Element
description:
Assistant controls (spec section 13.4): the person decides what the
assistant may do without asking, what it remembers and how much context it
uses. These are the person's settings, not the assistant's work, so the
pattern has no AI mark, no status pill and no state of its own. The host
owns every setting and enforces it; the pattern shows them and reports the
person's choices. An irreversible action stays at «اسأل دائمًا» whatever
level the host passes, and a deleted memory stays until the host removes it.

agentPresentation.description: Optional identity in the existing task or answer header.

appearance.description: "card" sits on a tray; "plain" lives on its host's paper.

contextUsage.description: The context meter's data, shown as its detail view.

headingLevel.description: The title's level; the sections are one lower. 3 by default.

onMemoryDelete.description: Asks the host to delete an item; it stays until the host removes it.

onPermissionChange.description: The person's choice for an action; never called for a locked one.

title.description: The heading; «إعدادات المساعد» / Assistant controls by default.
